subject: displaying tip labels on subtrees and printing multiple subtrees on same image

messages.author: 8852cbecc35b43ee
messages.subject: displaying tip labels on subtrees and printing multiple subtrees on same image
parts:
Hi.

I'm using gzoom on a huge tree and would like to display all tip labels of the subtree, not just the number of tips as seen on this image, is there a way to do that?. Also, is there a way to display multiple subtrees on the same image?

Thanks!

messages.author: 8852cbecc35b43ee
messages.subject: Re: displaying tip labels on subtrees and printing multiple subtrees on same image
parts:
My command:

gzoom(tree_MLST, c("M63", "M64", "M65", "M66", "M67"), subtree=TRUE, widths = c(0.3, 0.7))
